PerfectCurse:CurseBloodPower.title: Curse Blood
PerfectCurse:CurseBloodPower.description: Whenever you draw a Curse, gain #b{Amount} Strength.
PerfectCurse:StarlightAegisPower.title: Starlight Aegis
PerfectCurse:StarlightAegisPower.descrip: Whenever you draw a Curse, gain #b{Amount} Block.
PerfectCurse:RideThePoisonPower.title: Ride the Poison
PerfectCurse:RideThePoisonPower.descript: Drawn Curses trigger immediately and are Exhausted, then ALL enemies gain #b{Amount} Poison.
PerfectCurse:MaliciousInfusionPower.desc: At the start of your next turn, Summon #b{Amount}.
PerfectCurse:DissociationPower.title: Dissociation
PerfectCurse:DissociationPower.descripti: Become Confused next turn, then remove that Confusion at the end of the turn.
PerfectCurse:BetrayalPower.title: Betrayal
PerfectCurse:BetrayalPower.description: At the start of each of your next #b{Amount} turns, lose 1 Energy.
PerfectCurse:WeightlessnessPower.title: Weightlessness
PerfectCurse:WeightlessnessPower.descrip: At the start of your next turn, invert your Strength and Dexterity.
